events.text: PB10 GK 2209 da clutch plate badalna painda, ₹14,500 lagega.
Kal Jaipur ke liye 18 ton ka load hai, ₹42,000 bhada. Gaadi free hai?
Jaipur unload ho gaya ji, wapsi da load mil gaya Ludhiana da.
Sardar ji Panipat cross kar liya, 2 vaje tak Delhi pahunch jaavanga. Diesel advance ₹8,000 chahida.
Papa, fees di last date 30 Nov hai, CAD 4,200.
Gurpreet, Sunday nu Jalandhar aa jao, Paath rakhya hai.
Is mahine da diesel khata ₹1,86,000 ho gaya, 1 tareekh nu clear karna.
GST return 20 tareekh tak, saari bilty bhej do.
